name: BENDING SPOONS SPA
summary: Bending Spoons S.p.A., through its subsidiaries, acquires and transforms digital businesses in the United States, the United Kingdom, Germany, Poland, Canada, Japan, Australia, France, Brazil, Italy, and internationally. The company designs and develops software and platforms that support acquisitions, transformations, and ongoing optimizations.
